text:
Aisha: quick heads-up — Stela onboarding metrics show an 18-25% p95 latency increase on long prompts since yesterday. looks like KV cache churn + larger seq lengths. thinking a lightweight mitigation: int8 quant canary + region-aware routing for eu-heavy traffic, plus an eval run before any full swap.
Tom: can you paste a sample prompt and the current model/quant? want to see exact shapes before approving any change.
Aisha: current: redwood-phi-1.3 (fp16) serving from eu-west pool. sample prompt (sanitized): 'Summarize the following policy doc for a customer-facing FAQ...' ~2.8k tokens. tail latencies spike on repeated long contexts.
Jun: +1 on q8 canary. propose small % traffic (2-5%) + automated eval with strict thresholds. i'll wire up the eval harness against Stela's golden set. thresholds: see snippet below.
```yaml
eval_thresholds:
  rouge: 0.98
  semantic_similarity: 0.995
  max_quality_regress_pct: 1.0
```
Leo: SRE can handle the canary rollout. i'll validate autoscaler headroom and make sure there's a fallback route if anything fails. suggest route rule: prefer eu-west for EU users, fallback to global-hosted.
Aisha: plan outline: 1) start 2% q8 canary in eu-west 2) run eval for 2h 3) if pass, ramp to 30% over 4h 4) full swap and cut route. i'll coordinate the enablement call for Stela (15 min) to capture customer expectations + get them on the QA checklist.
Tom: FYI capture logs in ticket CS-4123. also flag renewal owner — this is a potential renewal risk if latency persists.
ops-bot: deploy job queued: canary-job-id=98765. monitoring: https://console.redwood/inference/98765 (metrics streaming).
ops-bot: canary started -> distributing 2% traffic to redwood-phi-1.3-q8 (eu-west).
Leo: quick checklist for rollout: confirm node GPU temps stable, autoscaler read 20% spare capacity, enable prefix caching for repeated session IDs.
Jun: i'll run the eval harness and post diffs here. capture both automated metrics + 10 manual samples for format regressions.
Aisha: i'll prep a 1-pager for Stela with expected latency improvement & conservative rollback timeline to ease renewal conversation.
ops-bot: canary job completed: canary-job-id=98765 status=SUCCESS metrics: p95 -17%, p50 -8%, cost_per_token -23%. artifact: s3://redwood-artifacts/98765/report.html
ops-bot: quality-delta: -0.6% (within threshold). tagging @jun_ml for eval artifacts.
Jun: eval summary attached: ROUGE=0.991, semantic_sim=0.997, manual issues=2/500 (minor formatting mismatches). recommend approve to ramp.
Tom: noted — I'll update CS-4123 with the results and ping the renewal owner to remove the immediate risk flag.
Aisha: awesome. proceeding with ramp to 30% over the next 4h. scheduling 15-min enablement with Stela for tomorrow 09:30 CET to walk through what changed and capture direct feedback. :rocket:
Leo: i'll monitor rollout and open rollback runbook if we see regressions.
Aisha: thanks team — will close loop here after full swap and add the feedback summary to the renewal packet.
